Neha belongs from Khudla village in Sarkaghat, Mandi district, Himachal Pradesh. She is widely known as Himachal Pradesh’s first woman truck driver. Nithari case: 13 death sentences, not 1 year of freedom - Koli's legal Odyssey
description: Surinder Koli, sentenced to death in 13 Nithari killings cases and once hours away from execution, spent nearly two decades fighting to prove his innocence. After the Allahabad high court acquitted him in 12 cases, the Supreme Court cleared him in the last case in November 2025. Koli, who often argued his own cases from jail, walked free after nearly 19 years behind bars. He was found dead in Haridwar on Friday, less than a year after his release.

title: Wilt Chamberlain’s $1 million estate sells for $9.7 million after renovation
description: Basketball legend Wilt Chamberlain's Bel-Air mansion has sold for approximately $9.7 million. This sale concluded years of attempts to sell the property at a much lower price. The 9,395-square-foot home was originally commissioned by Chamberlain in 1971. After extensive renovations, the property was relisted multiple times with significant price cuts. The final sale price was nearly half of its highest asking price.
